title: Browser test workflow step
description: One step: an action (visit, click, fill, select, check, press, wait), an assertion or a review screenshot, its element and its input.

choices.label: fill — type into a field (input: text)
select — choose an option in a select (input: option value or label)
check — tick a checkbox or radio
press — press a key, optionally in an element (input: Enter, Tab, Control+a)
waitFor — wait for an element (input: visible, hidden, attached or detached)
expectHidden — an element is hidden or absent
expectText — an element shows text (input: text)
expectUrl — the address is a path (input: /path)
expectCount — how many elements match (input: number)
expectValue — a field holds a value (input: text)
screenshot — take a screenshot for human review, never compared (input: file name such as checkout-filled)

fields.label: Element (empty for goto, expectUrl, expectTitle and page-level press)
fields.help: Parent first, separated by >: button "Save", link "Next", label "Email", placeholder "Search", text "Welcome", testid "submit", form "Sign up" > button "Create account". Add exact for exact matching and #2 for the second match.

fields.label: Input (path, text, key, number or wait state; see the step list)
fields.help: Use {{data.path}} for test data, for example {{data.customer.email}}. Paths start with /.

fields.label: Capture the full scrollable page?
fields.no: No — the viewport, or the element above

fields.label: Elements to mask, such as dynamic data (optional, one locator per line)
fields.help: Masked elements are painted over in the PNG, for example testid "clock".

choices.label: Default — text contains; URL and title are exact
